title: Golden hour
notes: A rising crane with a slow push from low above the snow west of the Swanky Summit Lodge (it faces west: deck and glass dining room toward the camera) to about 18 m above the slope, looking east at the lodge, the Bowl Gondola base, the Summit Express base and the peak. A snow mound hides the lift bases in the first second (the reveal). Ground: 1078.1 at x 3030, 1081.2 at x 3038, 1083.5 at x 3045. State on bridgetrailer1g: a time jump to 2029-01-08 20:41 (lamps on), normalized date 0.655, temperature -8, cloudiness 0. On this save Time of Day 19.6 (block A's value on bridgetrailer1f) renders night with stars; 18.6 gives a warm peak and lit lodge windows in dusk, 18.0 a brighter, cooler light with the lodge front lit, 17.2 plain day. Take 3: 18.6. Take 4: 18.0. Path 9 s, then a 270-frame (4.5 s) hold on the last pose for the end card, then the UI returns. Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60). The dark, low-contrast frames defeat rec.mjs dedupe (mpdecimate); the takes were deduplicated with a luma-difference threshold of 0.1.
